title: Decomposition proposed by the model
description: What the model is allowed to hand the planner: the cut into PBIs, the declared paths, the declared dependencies, the references to ADR sections, and the two descriptions. Everything derived from these — the overlap graph, the parallel groups, the critical path — is the script's and is refused here with exit 5.

notes.description: Platform particulars of this repository worth carrying into every brief. Prose, never a decision.

key.description: Stable identity of this slice inside the plan. Re-running matches on it, so it must not change when the title is reworded.

result.description: What and why: how the world differs once the card is closed. Card only — the brief never restates it.

acceptance_criteria.description: Technical, checkable by a tester, and executable rather than desirable. Card only.

adr_sections.description: The sections of the ADR this slice was derived from. A slice referring to none was derived from nothing.

paths.description: Repository-relative paths this slice touches. A trailing slash declares a subtree; * ? [ make a glob. Inaccuracy is tolerated and errs toward an extra dependency.

depends_on.description: Keys of slices that must land first.

parallel_with.description: An assertion the script verifies, never the trigger of the check: naming a slice whose paths intersect these is exit 3.

where_to_look.description: Pointers for the agent: where to start, what carries the contract. Brief only.
